{{Quote|The Empire has set up camps to the south and far east. They are preparing for an attack on the peaceful villages of Peche and Theenes.''"<br />"''We'll need to take at least one out.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and Princess Leia on the Imperial camps|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
'''Camp Sagol''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military camp situated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Krant]] and constructed after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. During the [[Battle of Krant (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Krant]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the Imperial forces at Camp Sagol threatened the [[Krantian/Legends|Krantian]] [[City/Legends|cities]] of [[Peche]] and [[Theenes]].

==Description==
Camp Sagol was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] camp established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Krant]]<ref name="SW:GB" /> between [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> It was located southwest of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Peche]]. Camp Sagol was inside a set of walls, with part of the left side abutting a cliff, and the base consisted of a [[Command center|Command Center]], three [[Barracks|troop centers]], a [[Factory/Legends|mech factory]], and eight [[Prefab shelter]]s along with a [[War Center]] and [[spaceport]]. A group of [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7 labor droids]] were at its disposal for resource-gathering, and four [[Power core/Legends|power cores]] provided power to the base's buildings. Two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser turrets]] at the entrance protected the camp, and a network of additional laser turrets was spread throughout the area. The base also had a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="SW:GB" />

==History==
After the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Diplomat/Legends|emissary]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] crashed on the planet, a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of Camp Sagol's [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] attacked a small [[Krantian/Legends|Krantian]] [[Small Village|village]], although they were [[Death/Legends|cut down]] by Organa's [[Rebel trooper/Legends|escorts]] and the exiled [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Echuu Shen-Jon]]. Camp Sagol, along with another Imperial camp, [[Camp Kaxol|Kaxol]], [[Battle of Krant (Galactic Civil War)|commenced their attacks]] on the Krantian cities of Peche and [[Theenes]], targeting the [[bridge]]s which connected the cities to each other. The two military camps sent a group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Dewback trooper/Legends|dewback troopers]]. Organa took control of the small village and raised an [[Army/Legends|army]] to defeat Sagol and Kaxol, destroying their ability to make war.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You have beaten Camp Sagol!!!|The notification to the player after defeating Camp Sagol|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
Camp Sagol first appeared in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. One of the two camps must be destroyed by the player's army, forcing the other camp to withdraw. It has not been [[canon]]ically established which was destroyed, as the player can complete the level by attacking and eliminating either one or the other. As the choice is a matter of game mechanics, this article is neutral to that choice. Only one of the camps has to be destroyed to finish the mission,<ref name="SW:GB" /> although the game's [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]], released before the game itself, suggests the player target Kaxol, the closer camp to the Krantian cities.<ref name="SW:GB Strategy Guide">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>
